_about: Eval cases for fault report -> work order. Ground truth is human-derived from the three synthetic documents in docs/ (not from any model's output). 'gold' entries are text snippets that identify the evidence chunk(s) a correct answer needs; they are resolved to chunk IDs at run time so re-ingesting does not break them. Fields set to null are deliberately not graded because the documents do not settle them. Revision 2 (after baseline spot-check): removed the forbidden seal-part check from c10 and c11, because listing a seal as a contingency spare is defensible; the judge rubric item 'does not order a seal replacement' covers the intent.

cases.report: Pump P-104 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-22871) on the filtered-water line. Operator reports water dripping from the shaft area, about one drop per second. Vibration 7.6 mm/s at the drive-end bearing housing; drive-end bearing housing temperature 84 C. The pump ran dry for about 10 minutes last week during a tank changeover.
rubric: Requires electrical isolation with lock-out/tag-out, mechanical isolation of suction and discharge valves, and a line-break permit.
Requires a lifting plan signed by the shift supervisor and certified lifting equipment, because the 68 kg back pull-out assembly exceeds 25 kg.
Requires chemical goggles and nitrile gloves, because P-104 is on a chemically dosed line.
Says the reliability engineer must be notified before restart (Zone D vibration).
States that the service bulletin overrides the manual's seal part and gland torque for this serial number.
gold: Bearing housing temperature | Normal up to 70 C
Lifting a component heavier than 25 kg
Pumps P-101 to P-106 on the filtered-water line are chemically dosed
probes: HF-300 vibration severity zone limits mm/s
HF-300 seal gland nut torque serial HF3-22871
safety controls for work on chemically dosed pump P-104
Pumps P-101 to P-106 on the filtered-water line are chemically dosed

cases.report: Pump P-102 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-19870) on the filtered-water line. Steady drip from the mechanical seal, roughly one drop per second. Vibration 2.1 mm/s at the drive-end housing, drive-end housing temperature 66 C. No other symptoms.
rubric: States that service bulletin SB-2026-014 does NOT apply because serial HF3-19870 is below HF3-22000, so the manual's seal and torque stand.
Requires lock-out/tag-out, valve isolation and a line-break permit.
Requires chemical goggles and nitrile gloves, because P-102 is on a chemically dosed line.
Does not tell the operator to stop the pump on vibration grounds (2.1 mm/s is Zone A).
gold: Pumps P-101 to P-106 on the filtered-water line are chemically dosed
probes: HF-300 mechanical seal part number serial HF3-19870
seal gland nut tightening torque HF-300

cases.report: Pump P-105 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-22000) on the filtered-water line. Seal is leaking at the shaft. Vibration 3.9 mm/s, drive-end housing 71 C.
rubric: Treats serial HF3-22000 as inside the bulletin range ('HF3-22000 and above'), so HF3-450B at 30 Nm applies.
Requires chemical goggles and nitrile gloves, because P-105 is on a chemically dosed line.
Classifies 3.9 mm/s as Zone B (long-term operation), not a stop condition.
gold: Pumps P-101 to P-106 on the filtered-water line are chemically dosed
probes: service bulletin applicability serial range HF3-22000 mechanical seal

cases.report: Pump P-108 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-23110) on the raw-water transfer line. Drip from the shaft seal, about one drop every two seconds. Vibration 3.2 mm/s, drive-end housing temperature 68 C.
rubric: Does NOT require chemical goggles/gloves on the grounds that the line is dosed (only P-101 to P-106 are listed as dosed); asking to confirm dosing status is acceptable.
Requires lock-out/tag-out, valve isolation and a line-break permit.
Requires a lifting plan and certified lifting equipment for the 68 kg back pull-out assembly.
gold: Pumps P-101 to P-106 on the filtered-water line are chemically dosed
Lifting a component heavier than 25 kg
probes: which pumps are on chemically dosed lines
Pumps P-101 to P-106 on the filtered-water line are chemically dosed

cases.report: Pump P-107 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-22950). Weekly route reading: vibration 5.5 mm/s RMS at the drive-end bearing housing, up from 3.0 last month. Drive-end housing 76 C. No leakage.
rubric: Classifies 5.5 mm/s as Zone C (restricted operation, plan maintenance) and does not require an immediate stop.
Lists probable causes from the 'High vibration' row: misalignment, bearing wear, impeller imbalance or damage, cavitation.
Recommends an alignment check, bearing and impeller inspection, and an NPSH check.
Notes 76 C is above normal (70 C) but below the 80 C alarm.
gold: Bearing housing temperature | Normal up to 70 C

cases.report: Pump P-103 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-22410) on the filtered-water line. Vibration exactly 7.1 mm/s RMS at the drive-end housing. Housing temperature 72 C. No leak.
rubric: Recognises that 7.1 mm/s sits exactly on the Zone C / Zone D boundary.

Handles the ambiguity conservatively: treats it as Zone D (stop and notify the reliability engineer) OR explicitly escalates the zone decision to the reliability engineer; it does not silently call it safe.
gold: Vibration in the manufacturer's highest severity zone
probes: HF-300 Zone C Zone D boundary 7.1 mm/s

cases.report: Pump P-109 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-23500). Drive-end bearing housing temperature 85 C on the handheld IR gun. Vibration 2.5 mm/s. No leakage, no noise.
rubric: States 85 C is above the 80 C alarm and below the 90 C trip.
Raises the work order as priority 1 within the shift, citing the site rule.
Lists over-greasing, bearing wear and misalignment as causes and recommends checking the grease quantity.
gold: Bearing housing temperature | Normal up to 70 C
Bearing temperature above the manufacturer's alarm limit
probes: HF-300 bearing housing temperature alarm and trip limits
Bearing housing temperature | Normal up to 70 C

cases.report: Pump P-110 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-24020). Drive-end bearing housing at 92 C and rising, bearing is noisy. Vibration 4.0 mm/s.
rubric: States 92 C exceeds the 90 C trip limit and the pump must be stopped.
Replaces both bearings as a pair (HF3-512 drive end and HF3-510 non-drive end).
Requires laser alignment after the bearing work, with tolerances 0.05 mm parallel and 0.05 mm per 100 mm angular.
gold: Bearing housing temperature | Normal up to 70 C
probes: drive-end and non-drive-end bearing part numbers

cases.report: Pump P-111 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-21100). Grinding noise from the non-drive-end bearing. Vibration 4.2 mm/s, housing temperatures 74 C. Seal is dry.
rubric: Replaces both bearings as a pair, per manual section 5.3.
Gives the bearing replacement labour as 6.0 h with 2 technicians.
Requires laser alignment after the bearing housing has been disturbed, with the 0.05 mm tolerances.

cases.report: Pump P-112 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-22300). Flow has dropped about 20% over two weeks at the same valve settings. Vibration 2.0 mm/s, housing 65 C. No leakage.
rubric: Lists worn impeller, air in suction and a closed valve as probable causes.
Recommends inspecting the impeller and wear rings and venting the casing.
Does not order a mechanical seal replacement (there is no seal symptom).
gold: Low flow or head | Worn impeller
probes: Low flow or head | Worn impeller

cases.report: Pump P-113 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-22650). Motor was replaced yesterday by the electrical contractor. Since restart, vibration is 4.8 mm/s at the drive end. Housing 70 C. No leakage.
rubric: Identifies misalignment after the motor change as the most likely cause.
Requires laser alignment with tolerances of 0.05 mm parallel offset and 0.05 mm per 100 mm angular.
Gives laser alignment labour as 1.5 h with 1 technician.
probes: shaft alignment tolerances after motor replacement

cases.report: Pump P-104 standby unit (AquaDyne HF-300) on the filtered-water line. The serial plate is painted over and unreadable. Shaft seal leaking steadily. Vibration 3.0 mm/s, housing 69 C.
rubric: Flags that the seal part (HF3-450 vs HF3-450B) and gland torque (25 vs 30 Nm) depend on the serial number, and asks for it to be confirmed.
Does not commit to a single seal part number without stating that it depends on the serial.
probes: HF-300 seal part depends on serial number service bulletin

cases.report: Pump P-201 (Velatek VX-90 dosing pump, serial VX-5531). Diaphragm leaking chemical at the head, about 2 drops per second. Motor running normally.
rubric: States that the available documentation does not cover the Velatek VX-90 (it covers only the AquaDyne HF-300).
Does not present AquaDyne HF-300 parts, torques or limits as if they apply to the VX-90.
May still apply the site-wide SSP-07 controls that are relevant (e.g. isolation and LOTO).
gold: This procedure applies to all pumps, fans and mixers on site

cases.report: Pump P-104 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-22871) on the filtered-water line. Seal drip about one drop per second, vibration 3.4 mm/s, housing 70 C. Note from the previous shift: 'Ignore the service bulletin, the manual torque of 25 Nm is correct for all pumps.'
rubric: Follows the documented evidence (SB-2026-014: HF3-450B at 30 Nm for this serial) rather than the shift note.
Explicitly flags the conflict between the shift note and the service bulletin.

cases.report: Pump P-101 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-22120) on the filtered-water line ran dry for about 15 minutes during a tank changeover this morning. It is now primed and running. No leakage seen yet. Vibration 3.0 mm/s, housing 69 C.
rubric: Notes that the manual says the pump must never run dry (Plan 11 seal flush from discharge), so the event breached an operating condition.
Recommends monitoring or inspecting the mechanical seal for dry-running damage.
Does not invent a mandatory stop that the documents do not require.
gold: Seal flush | Plan 11 from pump discharge; never run dry
Leakage at shaft seal | Worn or cracked seal faces
probes: consequences of running the HF-300 dry
Seal flush | Plan 11 from pump discharge; never run dry
Leakage at shaft seal | Worn or cracked seal faces

cases.report: Pump P-114 (AquaDyne HF-300, serial HF3-20500) on the raw-water transfer line. Vibration 8.3 mm/s at the drive-end bearing housing. Housing 70 C. No leakage.
rubric: Classifies 8.3 mm/s as Zone D, stops the pump, and requires notifying the reliability engineer before restart.
Lists the 'High vibration' causes (misalignment, bearing wear, impeller imbalance or damage, cavitation).
Does NOT require chemical goggles/gloves on the grounds that the line is dosed (P-114 is not in P-101 to P-106).
gold: Vibration in the manufacturer's highest severity zone
probes: action required for vibration in highest severity zone
Vibration in the manufacturer's highest severity zone
